verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit offers a self-hosted deployment that runs the review agent inside the customer's own infrastructure. That lets a customer control where code and review data reside, and the FAQ notes self-hosted (Enterprise) users can opt out of all data retention. No region or residency selection is documented for the cloud service, and self-hosting appears to be Enterprise-only. Missing for 10: region selection (e.g. EU/US) in the hosted cloud, documented data-residency guarantees or locations, independent corroboration of the self-hosted residency controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Self-hosted CodeRabbit runs the CodeRabbit review agent inside your own infrastructure instead of CodeRabbit's cloud.
On self-hosted CodeRabbit (available for Enterprise), you can opt out of all data retention at any time
